description: For iglootools Python projects, on top of base: extend it as github>iglootools/common//renovate/python#v<version>. See guidelines/project-setup/python-tooling.md, Pin the build backend explicitly.

customManagers.description: [tool.uv] build-constraint-dependencies pins the PEP 517 build backend closure, which uv.lock does not resolve and no built-in manager reads. The two matchStrings run under the recursive strategy: the first isolates the array, the second captures every pin in it; a single anchored regex extracts only the first. Renovate does not re-lock for a regex manager's bump, so the shared renovate-mise-lock workflow runs uv lock on the branch.

The iglootools command, a dev dependency pinned by tag as a PEP 508 direct reference (iglootools @ git+https://github.com/iglootools/common@vX.Y.Z). No built-in manager moves a git reference there, so without this a bump of common moved the workflows and presets but not the command, leaving the pins disagreeing, which lint-common-pins fails. The shared renovate-mise-lock workflow then runs uv lock on the branch, re-resolving the tag in uv.lock.
